Title: RXNFP - chemical reaction fingerprints
Description: Encodes a whole chemical reaction, rather than a single molecule, as 256 features read from a BERT model trained on reaction SMILES. Schwaller and colleagues fine-tuned it to assign reaction classes, reaching 98.9% accuracy, and found that mechanistically related transformations end up close together in the learned space. This lets chemists retrieve nearest-neighbour reactions and map reaction space without annotating reaction centres or separating reactants from reagents. A complete reaction string is required, so the fingerprint cannot be computed from a product alone.
Interpretation: 256 features encoding a chemical reaction from an attention-based reaction transformer.
